name: Apply Ceiling Primer (Spray + Backroll)
intent: Spray PVA primer onto bare drywall ceiling, immediately backroll wet film to work primer into mud joints. Cut in the wall line with brush after the spray pass to clean up overspray on the masking tape. NC ceiling production standard.

tasks.name: Cut-In Wall Line After Ceiling Spray

doctrine: Spray ceiling primer at 500 SF/hr is ~17% slower than spray wall primer (600 SF/hr) because the sprayer is working overhead. Backroll at 325 SF/hr is ~19% slower than wall backroll (400 SF/hr) for the same reason — and the backroller is fighting gravity to keep the roller from sagging. Post-spray cut-in (100 LF/hr) is faster than freehand cut-in because the painter is cutting against tape, not freehand. The wall has been masked by MOD_SETUP_CEIL_MASK_ADJACENT before this module fires.
